from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single research paper from the collection, capturing its title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this specific paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers that this document explicitly references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
